description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the Accuracy (%) of various methods across three different evaluation categories. The horizontal category axis displays three groups in the following order: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, without a specific overarching axis label. The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and uses a linear scale that starts at 50 and extends slightly above 62, with numeric tick marks at regular intervals of 2 units. The bars are arranged in groups of six for each category, representing different methods distinguished by color and pattern as indicated by the legend: a light blue hatched bar with diagonal lines (DAPO), a solid blue bar (DAPO+Self-reflection), a light orange hatched bar (GRPO), a solid orange bar (SRPO), a green hatched bar (PPO), and a solid green bar whose corresponding legend text is obscured by a grey rectangle. Within each category group, the bars are ordered from left to right as DAPO, DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, SRPO, PPO, and the unlabeled solid green bar. Across the entire chart, the lowest accuracy is observed in the Mathverse category for the DAPO method at approximately 53.1%, while the highest accuracy is found in the Physics category for the DAPO+Self-reflection method at approximately 61.0%. In the middle MMLU category, the values range from roughly 54.6% for PPO to 57.1% for SRPO. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted alphabetically or by value, and all bars are visually emphasized with black outlines, while dashed light grey grid lines are present in the background.
